blocks.tamil_translation: وَالصَّلَاةِ النَّافِعَةِ صَلِّ عَلَي مُحَمَّدٍ وَارْضَ عَنْهُ رِضاً لَا تَسْخَطُ بَعْدَهُ) “O Allah! Lord of this perfect call (the Adhan) and of the beneficial Salah! Shower mercy upon Hazrat Muhammad ﷺ! Be pleased with him in such a way that You are never displeased after this!” — whoever makes this Du'a, Allah will accept his Du'a,” Hazrat Jabir (RA) narrates that Rasulullah ﷺ said.

blocks.arabic_text: عَنْ أَنَسِ بْنِ مَالِكٍ ﵁ قَالَ: قَالَ رَسُولُ اللهِ ﷺ: الدُّعَاءُ لَا يُرَدُّ بَيْنَ اْلاَذَانِ واْلإِقَامَةِ، قَالُوا: فَمَاذَا نَقُولُ يَارَسُولُ اللهِ؟ قَالَ: سَلُوا اللهَ الْعَافِيَةَ فِي الدُّنْيَا وَاْلآخِرَةِ.
blocks.source_reference_arabic: رواه الترمذي وقال: هذا حديث حسن باب في العفو والعافية، رقم:٣٥٩٤
blocks.tamil_translation: Hazrat Anas ibn Malik (RA) narrates that when Rasulullah ﷺ said, “The Du'a made between the Adhan and the Iqamah is not rejected (it is accepted),” the Sahabah asked, “O Rasulullah! What should we ask for?” The Prophet ﷺ replied, “Ask Allah for well-being in this world and the Hereafter!”

blocks.arabic_text: عَنْ جَابِرٍ ﵁ أَنَّ رَسُولَ اللهِ ﷺ قَالَ: إِذَا ثُوِّبَ بِالصَّلَاةِ فُتِحَتْ أَبْوَابُ السَّمَاءِ وَاسْتُجِيبَ الدُّعَاءُ.
blocks.tamil_translation: “When the Iqamah is called for Salah, the doors of the heavens are opened and Du'as are accepted,” Hazrat Jabir (RA) narrates that the Prophet ﷺ said.

blocks.arabic_text: عَنْ أَبِي هُرَيْرَةَ ﵁ يَقُولُ: مَنْ تَوَضَّأَ فَأَحْسَنَ وُضُوءَهُ، ثُمَّ
